verdict.rationale: Lever documents its own Career Site Builder: a no-code, template-based career site that the hiring team can brand with the company logo, colors and font, which covers the branded, no-engineering part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the site is served on the customer's own domain, or that jobs publish to it automatically from the ATS. missing for 10: custom-domain hosting, documented automatic job publishing from the ATS to the careers page, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Anyone on your hiring team can craft a compelling career site in minutes — no design or coding experience necessary.
Add your company logo, color scheme, and primary font
Take advantage of out-of-the-box templates. Point-and-click edits, no coding required.
